# SABnzbd 5.1.3's requirements.txt, resolved and pinned with hashes for the Unraid
# all-in-one image (Python 3.12; the pins are the same for x86-64 and ARM64). pip installs
# it with --require-hashes, so a file that changed on PyPI fails the build. req.in below is
# SABnzbd's requirements.txt without notify2 (desktop pop-ups over D-Bus, which a container
# has no use for). Everything is a prebuilt wheel but sgmllib3k (feedparser's), which PyPI
# has only as source: the Dockerfile installs the setuptools pinned here first and builds
# sgmllib3k against it, never against one pip would fetch unchecked.
# Regenerate it when SABnzbd is bumped, and check aarch64 resolves to the same pins:
#   uv pip compile req.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-header

    --hash=sha256:ffe9860d99cbde05fd156c610d4bcb49d953200c4ed3cb2db001ed50722fc142
    # via -r req.in
